2.  The present appeal is filed by the Appellant-State under Section 377 of the CrPC assailing the judgment of conviction and order on sentence dated 10th July, 2019 passed by the ld. ADJ-Special Fast Track Court (North) Rohini, Delhi in SC No. 58275/2016 arising out of FIR No.172/2009,
under Sections 376(2)(g)/376/366A/354/506/34 of the IPC, registered at PS Prashant Vihar,
whereby the Accused-Respondents Parvesh Rana and Ashish Sherawat were sentenced to imprisonment already undergone as an under- trial prisoner, i.e., approximately 6 years and 5.5 years respectively) along with a fine of Rs. 40,000/- and Rs. 60,000/- respectively.
3. Learned APP for the State seeks time to cite authorities to justify enhancement of sentence of the accused.
4. The Respondents shall furnish bail bonds for the sum of Rs. 10,000/-
